facts.fact: The ANEC director general cites RGPH-5 data showing 5.3% of the population and 8.9% of under-5s have no birth certificate, so the fifth census has been taken; the document gives no enumeration date and the year 2023 is inferred from his comparison with 2023 survey data.
The document cites EDS Continue 2023 as establishing that 81.4% of under-5s are registered; it gives no release date, so the document's published date is used.
